"""Observe existing resolver owners on immutable saved candidates, not video.

Adapted from the October 8 capture_stages.py/capture_assignments.py investigation.
Every wrapper returns the original result. Full completed equality is mandatory.
"""
from pathlib import Path
from dataclasses import asdict, fields
from enum import Enum
from copy import deepcopy
from unittest.mock import patch
import hashlib, json, math, subprocess, sys

root = Path.cwd()
out = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
prior = root / 'sample/output/s11-local-xy-implementation-20261009-001'
recipe = root / 'sample/output/s11-local-xy-exclusion-20261009-001/sample4-baseline/recipe.oilrecipe'
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'src'))
from oil_tracker.domain.detection import PhaseDetection, BoundaryCandidate
from oil_tracker.domain.enums import BoundaryKind, FillState
from oil_tracker.domain.recipe import InspectionRecipe
from oil_tracker.adapters.vision.observation_sequence_resolver import ObservationSequenceResolver
from oil_tracker.adapters.vision.oil_interface_selector import BoundedOilInterfaceSelector, oil_candidate_emission
from oil_tracker.adapters.vision.oil_interface_tracklets import DirectedInterfaceTrackletBuilder, _track_velocity
from oil_tracker.adapters.vision import foam_episode_resolver as foam_owner


def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def norm(v):
    if isinstance(v, Enum): return v.value
    if isinstance(v, float) and not math.isfinite(v): return str(v)
    if isinstance(v, dict): return {k: norm(x) for k, x in v.items()}
    if isinstance(v, (set, frozenset)): return sorted(norm(x) for x in v)
    if isinstance(v, (tuple, list)): return [norm(x) for x in v]
    return v

def save(name, value):
    p = out / name
    assert not p.exists(), name
    p.write_text(json.dumps(norm(value), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False) + '\n')

def ref(r):
    d = {f.name: getattr(r, f.name) for f in fields(r) if f.name not in ('candidate', 'evidence')}
    return dict(d, source=r.candidate.source, y=r.candidate.y, emission=oil_candidate_emission(r))

def node(n):
    return dict(kind=n.kind, identity=n.identity, emission=n.emission, ref=ref(n.candidate_ref) if n.candidate_ref else None)

def hypothesis(h):
    return {f.name: [ref(r) for r in h.members] if f.name == 'members' else getattr(h, f.name) for f in fields(h)}

def decode(d):
    d = deepcopy(d)
    d['fill_state'] = FillState(d['fill_state'])
    d['candidates'] = [BoundaryCandidate(**dict(c, kind=BoundaryKind(c['kind']))) for c in d['candidates']]
    return PhaseDetection(**d)

pre = json.loads((prior / 'preflight-v2.json').read_text())
source_pins = pre['source_files']
for name, pin in source_pins.items(): assert sha(root / name) == pin, name
inputs = [Path(__file__), recipe, prior / 'preflight-v2.json']
for variant in ('off', 'scoped'):
    folder = prior / f'v2-sample4-{variant}-NONE'
    summary = json.loads((folder / 'summary.json').read_text())
    for name in ('raw.json', 'completed.json'):
        assert sha(folder / name) == summary['outputs'][name], (variant, name)
        inputs.append(folder / name)
    inputs.append(folder / 'summary.json')
pins = {str(p.relative_to(root)): sha(p) for p in inputs}
save('preflight.json', dict(source_head=subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip(),
     input_pins=pins, source_pins=source_pins, video_read=False, detector_rerun=False,
     rule='Observe unchanged owners; full completed-field equality required before interpretation.'))
outputs = {}
for variant in ('off', 'scoped'):
    folder = prior / f'v2-sample4-{variant}-NONE'
    raw = json.loads((folder / 'raw.json').read_text())
    glass = InspectionRecipe.from_dict(json.loads(recipe.read_text())).glasses[0]
    resolver = ObservationSequenceResolver()
    captured = dict(selector=[], assignments=[], foam_windows=[])
    tracks = []
    selector_previous = []
    prepare = resolver._oil.admission_evidence.prepare
    def observe_prepare(*a, **kw):
        r = prepare(*a, **kw)
        captured['admission'] = [[ref(x) for x in group] for group in r[0]]
        return r
    resolver._oil.admission_evidence.prepare = observe_prepare
    lifecycle = resolver._oil.path_lifecycle.resolve
    def observe_lifecycle(*a, **kw):
        r = lifecycle(*a, **kw)
        captured['layers'] = [[node(n) for n in layer] for layer in r.layers]
        captured['paths'] = {k: [node(n) for n in getattr(r, k)] for k in ('best_path', 'bounded_path', 'spike_suppressed_path', 'path')}
        return r
    resolver._oil.path_lifecycle.resolve = observe_lifecycle
    censor = BoundedOilInterfaceSelector._censor_competing_tracklets
    def observe_censor(self, selected, layer, scores):
        result = censor(self, selected, layer, scores)
        captured['selector'].append(dict(before=node(selected), after=node(result),
           previous=node(selector_previous[-1]) if selector_previous else None,
           nodes=[dict(node(n), bounded_score=s) for n, s in zip(layer, scores, strict=True)]))
        selector_previous.append(result)
        captured['selector_policy'] = asdict(self.policy)
        return result
    ambiguities = DirectedInterfaceTrackletBuilder._ambiguities
    def observe_ambiguities(self, pairs):
        result = ambiguities(self, pairs)
        captured['assignments'].append(dict(frame_offset=pairs[0][4].frame_offset if pairs else None,
            pairs=[dict(cost=c, track=tid, confirmed=t.confirmed, last=hypothesis(t.last.hypothesis), velocity=_track_velocity(t), row=hypothesis(h)) for c, tid, hid, t, h in pairs],
            conflicted_tracks=sorted(t.identity for t in result[0]), conflicted_rows=sorted(result[1])))
        return result
    ordered = DirectedInterfaceTrackletBuilder._ordered_assignment_pairs
    def observe_ordered(self, pairs, conflicts):
        result = ordered(self, pairs, conflicts)
        captured['assignments'][-1]['assigned'] = [dict(cost=c, track=tid, row=hid) for c, tid, hid, t, h in self._greedy_assignments(result, conflicts)]
        captured['tracklet_policy'] = asdict(self.policy)
        return result
    finalize = DirectedInterfaceTrackletBuilder._finalize_track
    def observe_finalize(self, track):
        result = finalize(self, track)
        tracks.append(track)
        return result
    evaluate = foam_owner._foam_segment_evaluation
    def observe_foam(segment, glass):
        result = evaluate(segment, glass)
        if segment and segment[-1].frame_offset >= 100:
            captured['foam_windows'].append(dict(
                observations=[{f.name: dict(source=e.candidate.source, y=e.candidate.y) if f.name == 'candidate' else getattr(e, f.name) for f in fields(e)} for e in segment],
                evaluation=result.as_debug_dict()))
        return result
    with patch.object(BoundedOilInterfaceSelector, '_censor_competing_tracklets', observe_censor), \
         patch.object(DirectedInterfaceTrackletBuilder, '_ambiguities', observe_ambiguities), \
         patch.object(DirectedInterfaceTrackletBuilder, '_ordered_assignment_pairs', observe_ordered), \
         patch.object(DirectedInterfaceTrackletBuilder, '_finalize_track', observe_finalize), \
         patch.object(foam_owner, '_foam_segment_evaluation', observe_foam):
        result = resolver.resolve([decode(d) for d in raw], glass, glass.initial_state)
    actual = norm([asdict(d) for d in result.detections])
    expected = json.loads((folder / 'completed.json').read_text())
    if actual != expected:
        save(f'{variant}-mismatch.json', [dict(frame=a['frame_index'], keys=[k for k in a if a[k] != b[k]]) for a, b in zip(actual, expected, strict=True) if a != b])
    assert actual == expected, variant
    assert len(captured['selector']) == len(raw) == 113
    captured['tracks'] = [dict(identity=t.identity, confirmed=t.confirmed, termination_reason=t.termination_reason,
        observations=[{f.name: hypothesis(o.hypothesis) if f.name == 'hypothesis' else getattr(o, f.name) for f in fields(o)} for o in t.observations],
        windows={k: asdict(v) for k, v in t.window_evidence_cache.items()}) for t in tracks]
    # Keep the complete local trace. The tracked diagnostic receipt extracts decisive records.
    save(f'{variant}-trace.json', captured)
    outputs[f'{variant}-trace.json'] = sha(out / f'{variant}-trace.json')
    print(variant, '113/113 complete detections equal', 'tracks', len(tracks), flush=True)
for name, pin in (pins | source_pins).items(): assert sha(root / name) == pin, name
save('receipt.json', dict(status='COMPLETE', preflight_sha256=sha(out / 'preflight.json'), inputs_preserved=True,
    complete_output_equal=dict(off=113, scoped=113), source_files_identical_to_prior_run=len(source_pins),
    video_read=False, detector_rerun=False, completed_resolver_rerun=True, labels_changed=False, auto_acceptance=False, outputs=outputs))

"""Compare stored original pixels with stored Foam component front; no rerun."""
from pathlib import Path
import json, hashlib
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
root = Path.cwd()
out = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
prior = root/'sample/output/s11-local-xy-implementation-20261009-001'
folder = prior/'v2-sample4-scoped-FULL'
components = json.loads((folder/'foam.json').read_text())
inputs = {str((folder/'foam.json').relative_to(root)): hashlib.sha256((folder/'foam.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
frames = [1620, 1665, 1680]
records = []
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(10, 8.6))
for col, f in enumerate(frames):
    directory = next(folder.glob(f'oil-debug*/frames/*/f{f:09d}_*'))
    path = directory/'original_roi_512ed6ab.png'
    inputs[str(path.relative_to(root))] = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    pixels = np.asarray(Image.open(path).convert('RGB'))
    assert pixels.shape[:2] == (104, 104)
    c = next(c for c in components[f//15]['components'] if c['selected_component'])
    # Every saved local/source box pair identifies the crop origin independently.
    local = c['local_bbox_xyxy']; source = c['source_bbox_xyxy']
    x0, y0 = source[0]-local[0], source[1]-local[1]
    assert [source[2]-local[2], source[3]-local[3]] == [x0, y0] == [543, 798]
    for row in range(2):
        ax = axes[row, col]
        ax.imshow(pixels, extent=(x0, x0+104, y0+104, y0), interpolation='nearest')
        ax.set_xticks([]); ax.set_yticks([])
    axes[0,col].set_title(f'{f/30:g} s / f{f} — original', fontsize=11)
    # Display the scalar as a guide, not as a fitted physical support contour.
    y = c['source_front_y']
    axes[1,col].plot([578,610],[y,y],color='#00e5ff',linewidth=2.0)
    axes[1,col].set_title(f'Saved Foam-front proposal: Y{y:g}', fontsize=10)
    records.append(dict(frame_index=f, crop_origin=[x0,y0], source_path=str(path.relative_to(root)), component=c))
fig.suptitle('Separate Foam-front review: cyan is the saved detector proposal, not human truth\nOil target at the yellow/dark boundary remains confirmed; no pixel labels requested', fontsize=11)
fig.subplots_adjust(left=.02,right=.98,bottom=.025,top=.86,wspace=.035,hspace=.19)
image_path=out/'foam-front-review-v2.png'; assert not image_path.exists()
fig.savefig(image_path,dpi=180);plt.close(fig)
for p,h in inputs.items(): assert hashlib.sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h
receipt=dict(inputs=inputs,inputs_preserved=True,video_read=False,detector_rerun=False,new_human_review=False,
             review_status='PENDING',records=records,image_sha256=hashlib.sha256(image_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
(out/'foam-review-v2.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Saved three-frame original/guide review; four input hashes unchanged')
